user_query: Which VPN gateway should I use, and when is the old one retired?

retrieved_docs.text:
IT Bulletin #208
Primary gateway: vpn-west.campus.edu
Legacy vpn-east.campus.edu will be retired on October 31.
MFA is required for all faculty accounts.
